item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 30/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate today and tomorrow. The weather will improve with temperatures rising over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach Guangdong on Friday. It will become cool and windy with rain over the region in the latter part of this week. Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will become fine gradually over the coast of southern China early next week.
